title: Input symbol under a truncated input
statement: Let $x$ be a word over an alphabet $\Gamma$, let $m$ be a natural number, and let $c$ be a configuration on input $x$ and $c'$ a configuration on the prefix of $x$ of length at most $m$. If the two input-head positions are equal and the position in $c$ is at most $m$, then the symbols read under the input heads are equal.
hypotheses_covered: Configuration c' on the prefix x.take m
c's input-head position is at most m
